title: plugin-approvals: an approval request's notification names the record by its raw id (`crm_opportunity/<id>`), and opening one on an empty slot logs "cannot advance" just before routing to the administrators
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect, measured in a browser (item 1); item 2 is a `finding`, class b (a runtime text contradicting its own contract), measured at the same door.
`reach:` the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.1 (HotCRM `main` `4de5343e`), fresh database, no position staffed. Measured by the `repo:hotcrm` seat's dev while re-measuring objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2057, the release step of ruling `6108375797` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22824). The ruling's own criteria all passed; these two texts are what was left over.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01P8mZuzuyZAHSrgQKmv6ASv`) from the dev's report on hotcrm#2057 (comment `6181102861`). The seat re-read both producer lines on objectstack `origin/main` `086fa464`. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: objectstack triage, then the lane that owns `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals`.
Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, open + closed):
- "approval.requested notification body raw record id instead of record title is waiting on you" → 1 hit, #7345 (closed: the inbox record link dead-ends), a different defect.
- "approver expanded to nobody warn cannot advance admin_rescue log wording stale" → 24 hits. The closest are all closed: #22824 (the routing this measurement confirms), #22725, #22631 (three texts said opening notifies nobody), #22607 and #22683 (the lint remedy text). None covers either text below.

## 1. The request notification names the record by object and id

- **Seen:** the console bell popover and the live toast read `A decision on crm_opportunity/JCqLLy5dSug1MldB is waiting on you.` A grouped "Approval requested ×4" shows only that one line, so the administrator cannot tell which deal or account is waiting without opening each one.
- **Producer:** `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts:3598`: `body: \`A decision on ${input.object}/${input.recordId} is waiting on you.\`` (in 18.0.0-next.1 `dist/index.js` around line 5220). The body is pinned by `approval-requested-notification.integration.test.ts:193`.
- **Same family, already fixed elsewhere:** `920bc12` changed the approval action toasts to name the request by `record_title`.
- **Expected:** the notification names the record the way the approvals list does: its title, plus the object's label rather than its API name.

## 2. The slot warning says the request "cannot advance" on the path that then advances

- **Seen:** on that boot each save that opened an empty-bench request (`POST crm_account`, `POST crm_opportunity`, 4 in all) logged `[approvals] approver 'position:sales_manager' expanded to nobody — the slot routes to no one and the request cannot advance until someone is added or the approver is re-pointed`. Each line was followed at once by the "opening on this organization's administrators" WARN, and every one of those requests was then decided as an ordinary approval.
- **Producer:** `approval-service.ts:2216-2219` (`expandApprovers`, the per-slot WARN). It predates #22824 and says what #22824 retired: `openNodeRequest`'s docblock now reads "An empty slate under the default `onEmptyApprovers: admin_rescue` … opens on a NAMED slate too: the request organization's administrators", and the ruling retired the same "waits forever" claim from the build lint. The build's 8 `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` warnings were measured to have changed already ("… the request opens on the organization's administrators").
- **Expected:** the per-slot line says the slot is empty and what the node's `onEmptyApprovers` will do with it, or leaves that sentence to the node-level line that follows.

## Acceptance

- `approval.requested` names the record by title (and object label) in the inbox row, the bell and the toast; the integration pin follows.
- On an `admin_rescue` node whose organization has an administrator, no log line says the request cannot advance.
